title: Multi-omics analysis reveals that low cathepsin S expression aggravates sepsis progression and worse prognosis via inducing monocyte polarization.

models.outcome_definition: not explicitly stated (LASSO 'to obtain monocyte-related genes involved in prognosis'); paper's survival analyses use GSE65682 28-day survival
models.reported_performance: None for the 4-gene signature; only CTSS single-gene KM in GSE65682 and CTSS nomogram
models.source_location: Results (LASSO), Fig. 3B-C, Supplementary Table S4 (sheet 'Supplementary Tab 4', LASSO coefficients)

notes: Borderline eligibility: the 4-gene LASSO set is called a prognostic signature with coefficients in the supplement, but it is never scored or validated as a model; the paper then focuses on CTSS alone. The bulk dataset used for WGCNA/LASSO is not named (possibly GSE65682, which supplies survival data; uncertain). GSE131761 used for CTSS expression; GSE65682 for CTSS survival and DEG analysis; GSE207651 is mouse lung scRNA.
